source: 736 Night
target: 736 Noctis

source: Can you accept such an outcome?
target: Potesne talem exitum accipere?

source: Inside an empty house in Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, Angoulême de François, wearing a lion headdress, stood by the window, gazing down at the gas streetlamps below, patiently waiting.
target: Intra domum vacuam in Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, Angoulême de François, in capite leonino ornatus, ad fenestram stetit, lumina gasica in via deorsum inspiciens, patienter exspectans.

source: After losing contact, he and Hidden Blade had switched emergency communication methods. They aimed to quickly re-establish contact, even without Madame Hela’s messenger.
target: Postquam communicationem amiserat, ipse et Hidden Blade modos communicationis subitanei mutaverant. Celeriter contactum restituere intendebant, etiam sine nuntio Dominae Helae.

source: Early the previous morning, as soon as he had wrapped up the Moran Avigny case, he immediately tried to locate Hidden Blade.
target: Mane dīē prīmō, simul ac negotium de Moran Avigny confecerat, statim conatus est Hidden Blade invenire.

source: Finally, Hidden Blade Franca, dressed in her assassin outfit, emerged from the shadows.
target: Denique Hidden Blade Franca, vestita habitu sicario, ex umbris apparuit.

source: Angoulême cut right to it and asked, “Did you take down Moran Avigny?”
target: Angoulême ad rem pervenit et rogavit: “Moran Avigny interfectus es?”

source: “Otherwise?” Franca replied with a smile.
target: “Alioquin?” Franca subrisu respondit.

source: Although Overseer Perle’s vortex warning hung over Franca’s head like a sharp blade, preventing her from relaxing just because Moran Avigny was dead and she had the intel, Franca wouldn’t let it ruin her mood or make her solemn or anxious.
target: Quamquam monitum vortex Perlae super caput Francae pendebat, velut aculeus acutus, qui eam non sineret solum quia Moran Avigny mortuus esset et notitiam obtineret, Franca non sineret animum suum deprimere aut eam gravem atque anxiam reddere.

source: The Major Arcana card holders would naturally worry about something so serious, and she and the others just needed to follow orders and complete the missions. No point fretting.
target: Possessores chartarum Major Arcana naturaliter de rebus tam gravibus solliciti erant, atque illa cum ceteris modo mandata sequi et missiones perficere debebant. Nulla est causa sollicitandi.

source: Plus, the intel they obtained was crucial and valuable. Either the Eternal Blazing Sun Church or the Demoness Sect would definitely be grateful!
target: Praeterea, notitia quam obtinerunt erat crucialis atque pretiosa. Aut Ecclesia Solis Aeternae Incandens aut Secta Daemonum certe grata erit!

source: Franca was filled with anticipation over this.
target: Franca ex illa ratione exspectatione plena erat.

source: “It really was you guys…” Angoulême couldn’t help but sigh.
target: “Revera vos fuistis…” inquit Angoulême, nec potuit non suspirare.

source: Hidden Blade and her team really acted fast. They had mentioned dealing with a government minister, and not long after, they actually attacked and succeeded.
target: Hidden Blade et turma eius vere celeriter agnoverant. Ministerium regiminis tractandum memoraverant, et non multo postea oppugnaverunt et successerunt.

source: Franca covered for Lumian, saying, “We were waiting for Moran Avigny to walk into the mirror himself. Surprisingly, the Aurora Order suddenly assassinated him, forcing him into our trap early.”
target: Franca pro Lumiano excusavit, dicens: “Exspectabamus ut Moran Avigny ipse in speculum intraret. Mirum in modum, Ordo Aurorae eum subito interemit, coegens eum in insidias nostras mane incidere.”

source: Combined with the scene details, Angoulême slightly nodded and said, “So it was just a coincidence…”
target: Coniunctis rebus scaeniciis, Angoulême leviter annuit et dixit: “Ita, hoc solum fortuitum fuit…”

source: This aligned with what the Purifiers had confirmed.
target: Hoc congruebat cum quod Purificatores confirmaverant.

source: Angoulême then asked, “So where’s Moran Avigny now?”
target: Deinde Angoulême rogavit: “Ergo, ubi nunc est Moran Avigny?”

source: “Dead,” Franca said with a tongue click. “He was definitely a Mirror Person, and gave us lots of important intel.”
target: “Mortuus,” inquit Franca, simul et lingua percussa; “Certe homo specularis fuit, atque nobis multam notitiam pretiosam dedit.”

source: “What intel?” Angoulême quickly asked.
target: “Quam notitiam?” statim Angoulême rogavit.

source: Franca chuckled and raised her right hand, gently rubbing her thumb and index finger together. “Where’s my informant fee?”
target: Franca subridens manum dexteram levavit, leniter pollicem et indicem inter se frotans, et inquit: “Ubi est praemium meum?”

source: Angoulême said in exasperated amusement, “Don’t forget I contributed a lot to the Moran Avigny operation. Even if I don’t get spoils, it’s no problem to hear the intel, right?”
target: Angoulême, vexato sed laeto, dixit: “Ne obliviscaris me ad rem Moran Avigny multum contulisse. Etiamsi praeda mihi non tradita sit, audire notitiam nihil impedit, nonne?”

source: Franca, who always prided herself on fairly “splitting loot,” awkwardly cleared her throat.
target: Franca, quae semper in aequa praedarum divisione se gloriabat, infauste guttur purgavit.

source: “Just kidding. Just kidding. But that intel is super important. Your superior will definitely reward you. Don’t forget to help me collect my fee!”
target: “Modo iocus erat. Modo iocus erat. Sed notitia illa est valde momenti. Superior tuus certe te remunerabit. Ne obliviscaris me adiuvare ut praemium meum colligam!”

source: “Get to the point,” Angoulême replied in a deep voice.
target: Angoulême respondit voce profunda: “Ad rem veni.”

source: It wasn’t that he was stingy about the fee, but Hidden Blade had twice emphasized how crucial the intel was, making him eager.
target: Non enim id erat quod de praemio parsimonia ageret, sed Hidden Blade bis extolliverat quantum notitia esset praecipua, id quod eum excitavit.

source: Franca omitted Tarot Club and Aurora Order details, but started from capturing Jebus to Overseer Perle’s painted self appearing and Lumian’s theory about the whole situation.
target: Franca de notis de Tarot Club et Ordo Aurorae omisit, sed narrationem ab apprehensione Jebus usque ad apparitionem pictam Overseer Perlae atque ad theoriam Lumiani de tota re incipere coepit.

source: Initially, Angoulême stayed relatively composed. Mirror People problems barely factored into Purifier expectations. But when Moran Avigny was tricked into revealing Roselle Gustav led the Mirror People, Angoulême’s head started buzzing louder and louder.
target: Initio, Angoulême paulo compositus mansit. Quaestiones de hominibus specularibus vix in exspectationibus Purificatorum habebantur. Sed cum Moran Avigny decipiebatur ut revelaret Roselle Gustav, ducem hominum specularum, caput eius magis ac magis vibrari coepit.

source: Why do Hidden Blade and the others always get mixed up in such major situations?
target: Cur Hidden Blade et ceteri semper in talibus rebus gravibus implicantur?

source: How long has it been since the Hostel incident? Why is there another “vortex”?
target: Quamdiu ab incidente Hostel praeteriit? Cur alius “vortex” apparuit?

source: After Franca finished, Angoulême couldn’t help but raise his right hand and pinch his throbbing, headdress-concealed forehead. His emotions were so scrambled he was speechless.
target: Postquam Franca finivit, Angoulême manum dexteram levavit et frontem, sub ornatu celatam atque pulsante, premeo; animi eius motus tam confusi erant ut nihil diceret.

source: Franca smugly asked, “How’s that? Project Vortex, the Mirror People, and intel about a hidden traitor—pretty important stuff, right?”
target: Franca superba rogavit: “Quid agitur? Projectum Vortex, homines speculares, atque notitia de latente proditore—res potissimum momenti, nonne?”

source: Noticing Angoulême’s grave gaze and slightly moving, teeth-grinding mouth, Franca instinctively added, “Don’t blame me! We’re not causing these problems, Trier’s just uniquely prone to all kinds of chaos. We’re victims too!”
target: Animadvertens Angoulême vultum grave et os paulum mobile, dentes stridentes, Franca instinctive addidit: “Noli me culpare! Non nos has difficultates inferimus; Trier solum ad omnia tumulta destinata est. Et nos victimae sumus!”

source: Angoulême slowly exhaled and said, “I’ll… submit this intel… tonight. I won’t forget to pass along my informant’s reward request. What do you want?”
target: Angoulême paulatim suspiravit et dixit: “Hanc notitiam hac nocte tradam. Non obliviscar adferre petitionem praemii informatorii meae. Quid vis?”

source: At the mention of “tonight,” Angoulême’s emotions surged and he paused a moment.
target: Ad dictum “hac nocte”, animi Angoulême impetu surrexerunt et paulisper subsistens fuit.

source: He had just finished his workday an hour ago and left Saint Viève Cathedral. Now he had to return!
target: Iam operam diei finivit et a Cathedralia Sanctae Viève discessit. Nunc redire debet!

source: I’m Agent 007, not some societal slave working from midnight to midnight every damn day! Angoulême inwardly cursed, but still appeared calm, reliable, and emotionally stable.
target: Ego sum Agens 007, non aliquis servus socialis qui ab media nocte ad mediam noctem omni die laborat! Angoulême interno maledixit, sed tamen apparuit placidus, fidēlis, atque animi constanti.

source: Franca deeply pondered and said, “All the Pleasure potion ingredients.”
target: Franca alte meditata est et dixit: “Omnia ingredientia potionis Voluptatis.”

source: She had considered her Affliction potion could be rewarded by the Demoness Sect, but not Jenna’s. She could only rely on the authorities.
target: Putaeā potionem Affliction suam a Secta Daemonum remunerari posse – sed non Jennae – solum in auctoritatibus confidere poterat.

source: “Aren’t you already at Pleasure?” Angoulême muttered, giving up asking. He nodded, “I’ll help get it.”
target: “Nonne iam in Voluptate es?” Angoulême submurmuravit, quaestionem relinquens. Deinde annuit: “Adiuvabo ut eam obtineam.”

source: He didn’t ask about Hidden Blade’s Pleasure potion preparations, just as he didn’t ask how she and her crew survived facing a demigod’s painted self.
target: Non quaesivit de praeparationibus potionis Voluptatis Hidden Blade, sicut nec interrogavit quomodo illa et turma eius superaverint se adversus demigodum se pictum.

source: Franca was overjoyed at 007’s promise.
target: Franca exsultabat ob promissum Agentis 007.

source: Getting Pleasure from the Church and Affliction from the Demoness Sect, surely Madam Judgment would reward me too. I sold this one intel three times… I can now understand Lumian’s glee at triple-dipping mission rewards!
target: Ex Ecclesia Voluptatem ac ex Secta Daemonum Afflictionem obtinendo, certissime Domina Judgment quoque mihi remunerabit. Notitiam hanc ter vendidi… nunc intelligere possum laetitiam Lumiani propter missionum triplicem praemiationem!

source: Angoulême rubbed his temples and muttered, “There are Cardinals not from the Sun pathway, and way more diocese bishops. I really don’t know what we’ll uncover next. I just hope the impact isn’t too massive.”
target: Angoulême tecta sua fricavit et submurmuravit: “Sunt cardinales extra iter Solis, ac multo plures episcopi dioecesani. Vere nescio quid deinceps detegamus; spero tantum effectum non nimis ingentem futurum esse.”

source: He meant the April Fool’s insider in the Eternal Church. With a clear lead, it wouldn’t be hard for that party to be discovered, even if they worked through a Broker.
target: Id significabat societatem Aprilis Insularum inter Ecclesiam Aeternam. Claro duce, non difficile erit illam partem inveniri, etsi per intermediarium operentur.

source: Without waiting for Franca’s reply, Angoulême pondered a moment and said, “The humanoid Sealed Artifact transaction is approved. Let me know the transaction details anytime.”
target: Sine responsione Francae exspectando, Angoulême paulisper cogitavit et dixit: “Transactio Artefacti Signati Humanoidis approbata est. Notitia negotiationis quovis tempore mihi tradita sit.”

source: “It’s finally approved…” Franca criticized the bureaucracy and curiously asked, “What’s the story with that humanoid Artifact?”
target: “Denique approbatum est…” inquit Franca, bureaucratiam condemnans, et curiosa rogavit: “Quid est fabula de illo Artefacto Humanoideo?”

source: She had encountered the humanoid Sealed Artifact during the sea prayer ritual and knew its abnormal power.
target: Illa artefactum Humanoide Signatum in ritu orationis maritimae occurrerat et eius vim insolitam noverat.

source: Angoulême shook his head. “I’m not cleared for that intel. All I know is she used to be a Sequence 4 Spectator demigod. Later she suddenly went insane, but I don’t know if she went mad before an evil god corrupted her, or because of the corruption.”
target: Angoulême caput vertit et dixit: “Non sum concessus ad hanc notitiam. Scio tantum eam olim fuisse demigodum Spectatorem Ordine IV. Postea subito insanivit, sed nescio an insanivit antequam deus malus eam corrumpisset, an propter ipsam corruptionem.”

source: “It was probably the latter,” Franca said thoughtfully. “Aren’t Spectator Beyonders usually emotionally stable and hard to lose control?”
target: “Forsitan alterum fuit,” inquit Franca cogitans. “Nonne Spectatores Beyonders plerumque animi constanti sunt et difficile est eis moderationem perdere?”

source: Angoulême rejected Franca’s statement. “From what I know, Spectators normally don’t have issues. But when they do, it gets really messy.”
target: Angoulême proclamationem Francae reiecit: “Ex iis quae scio, Spectatores plerumque problemata non habent; sed cum occurrunt, res vere confunduntur.”

source: “True,” Franca thought of I Know Someone.
target: “Vere,” Franca cogitavit, meminens I Know Someone.

source: After chatting a while, Angoulême bid Hidden Blade farewell and left the empty room.
target: Postquam aliquantulum colloquebantur, Angoulême Hidden Blade valedixit et ex illa camera inhāna discessit.

source: Before leaving, he quickly reviewed the intel, then inwardly sighed with a heavy heart.
target: Antequam discessit, celeriter notitiam recensuit, deinde corde gravi intus suspiravit.

source: Aren’t there way too many mystical incidents in Trier?
target: Nonne nimis sunt casus mystici in Trier?

source: In the market district, Jenna seized a chance to act as a Witch again.
target: In regione mercatoria, Jenna occasionem arripuit ut iterum magā agirent.

source: Wearing a black cloak and dark dress, she walked the shadowed street, pondering new acting directions as she looked for an opportunity.
target: Nigro pallio et veste obscura indūta, viam umbratam ambulavit, novas rationes agendi meditans dum occasionem quaerebat.

source: I can’t just equate Witches with bad deeds. Sinister, dark acts aren’t necessarily bad…
target: Non possum magās cum malis factīs aequare. Acta sinistra et obscura non necessario mala sunt…

source: Among the Witch legends I’ve gathered so far, many focused on Witches using mystical and sinister dark powers to help others fulfill desires, tempting them to stumble…
target: Inter fabulas de magā quae adhuc collegi, multae spectabant magās uti potentiis mysticis et sinistris obscuris ad alios adiuvandos, ut desideria perficerent, eos ad lapsum incitantes…

source: These legends likely contain remnants of acts by Demonesses posing as Witches. I could try imitating them. Plus, tempting others into depravity is a deeper way for an Instigator. Pleasure’s acting also corrupts the target…
target: Hae fabulae probabiliter reliquias continent actuum daemonissārum, quae ut magā se praebuerunt. Possum conari eas imitari. Praeterea, alios in pravitatem inducere via profunda est ad instigationem; actus Voluptātis quoque scopus corrumpit…

source: Yes, the mystical powers of sinisterness and darkness, tempting depravity and depravity brings calamity…
target: Ita, potentiae mysticae sinistritātis et tenebrarum, pravitatem incitantes, calamitatem afferunt…

source: Jenna’s thoughts gradually became more clear.
target: Cogitationes Jennae paulatim evidentiores factae sunt.

source: With these in mind, she turned onto Rue Anarchie, intending to find a chance to act as a Witch on this chaotic street.
target: His in mente habitīs, illa in viam “Rue Anarchie” versa est, intentā ut occasionem in hac via confusa ut magā agiret inveniret.

source: After a few steps, Jenna suddenly heard someone singing hysterically, “Trier, a city dressed in gold,
target: Post paucos passūs, Jenna subito aliquem audivit histrionicē cantantem: “Trier, urbs auro indūtā,

source: “A ball that endures ’til dawn unfolds;
target: Saltātiō quae usque ad auroram extenditur;

source: “Chicken roasted, dripping with oil’s grace,
target: Pullus assus, oleī grātiā stillans,

source: “A castle cake to fill each eager embrace.
target: Placenta castrōrum, quae singulōs amplexūs avidos implet.

source: “A bow-tied attendant glides ‘mongst the guests,
target: Minister, nodo papilionī ligātus, inter hospitēs labitur,

source: “Merrily dancing with joy and delight.
target: Hilariter saltat cum gaudio et delectātiōne.

source: “My beloved, hidden ‘midst the crowd,
target: Carus meus, inter turbam abscondītus,

source: “Among them, my love resides,
target: Inter eōs, habitat amor meus,

source: “In the Capital of Joy, forever Trier!”
target: In capite laetitiāe, in aeternum Trier!”

source: This voice… Jenna peered from the shadows at Auberge du Coq Doré and saw Lumian, in a thick brown jacket, sitting on the third floor windowsill, holding a green liquid-filled bottle.
target: Haec vox… Jenna ex umbrīs conspexit ad Auberge du Coq Doré et vidit Lumian, veste crassa fusca indūtus, sedens in limine fenestrae tertī tabulātī, tenens lagēnam virēdam plena liquoris.

source: Hadn’t he gone to the Aurora Order and never returned? Jenna frowned and stepped out of the shadow.
target: Numquid non ivit Ordo Aurorae et numquam rediit? Jenna fronte contrīta ex umbrā processit.

source: Lumian noticed her and smiled. He leaped down from the third floor, landing steadily before her.
target: Lumian eam animadvertit et risit. E fenestra tertiā, deiecit, et ante eam firmē consedit.

source: “Why are you here?” Jenna asked with concern.
target: “Cur hic es?” inquit Jenna sollicite.

source: Lumian smiled casually. “I suddenly missed this place. Came back for a drink.”
target: Lumian libenter risit. “Subitō hunc locum desideravi. Redīī ad potum.”

source: Sensing Lumian’s strange excitement, Jenna pondered a moment then asked, “Did something happen?”
target: Sentientī Lumiani excitātōrem mirum, Jenna paulisper meditāta est deinde rogavit: “Acciditne aliquid?”

source: “No,” Lumian denied quickly. He emphasized, “I’m fine.”
target: “Non,” celeriter negavit Lumian. Insisterat: “Ego valeō.”

source: With an absinthe bottle in hand, he headed towards Rue Anarchie’s exit. Jenna trailed closely behind, not inquiring further.
target: Absynthī lagēnam in manu habens, ad exitum Rūe Anarchie properavit. Jenna prope secuta est, ulterius non interrogāns.

source: Under the crimson moonlight and scattered gas lamps, the silent Lumian suddenly smiled and announced, “I’m about to start blaspheming. No, it’s already begun.”
target: Sub luce lunāri coccineā et lampadibus gasicis dispersīs, silentiosus Lumian subito risit et annuntiāvit: “Mox blasphemāre incipiam. Minime, iam coepit.”

source: He didn’t turn around and kept walking.
target: Non se vertit et ambulāre continuit.

source: “Haven’t you been blaspheming all this while?” Jenna cautiously probed with Lumian’s usual self-deprecation.
target: “Numquid totum hunc tempus blasphemāstī?” inquit Jenna cautius, consuētā sui deprecatione ad Lumian.

source: Lumian’s gaze stayed fixed ahead as he smiled. “It’s different this time.”
target: Aspectus Lumiani ante se fixus remansit dum risit: “Hoc tempore aliud est.”

source: He quickened his pace and didn’t mention it again.
target: Celeritātem acceleravit nec rē iterum dīxit.

source: Jenna glanced at Lumian’s muddy leather boots and the dirty but dry surroundings. She pursed her lips and didn’t press further.
target: Jenna conspexit calceamenta ex corio luto Lumiani et circumstantia sordida sed arida; labra comprimens, ulterius non quaesivit.

source: Lumian continued walking, occasionally humming a tune, occasionally chatting with Jenna and joking with a smile.
target: Lumian ambulāre continuit, interdum carmen hummandō, interdum cum Jenna colloquēns et subrīdēns iocāns.

source: He made his way back to his rented apartment and entered his room.
target: Ad locum conductum rediit et in conclāve intrāvit.

source: Jenna stood quietly in the living room, watching Lumian close the bedroom’s wooden door.
target: Jenna tranquille in conclāve vivendi stābat, spectāns Lumian lignārem iānam cubiculi claudere.

source: In the dark room, lit only by crimson moonlight, Lumian sat at his desk, unfolded a piece of paper, and picked up a fountain pen.
target: In conclāve obscūro, solum sub luce lunāri coccineō, Lumian ad mensam suam sedebat, chartam explicāvit, et stilum calamosum sustulit.

source: He didn’t light the gas wall lamp, nor create a blazing fireball. In the pitch‑black, he positioned the pen under the faint light.
target: Non accendit lampādum parietālem gasicum neque globum ignis ardentem creāvit. In tenebrīs impenetrābilibus, stilo sub tenuō lumine posuit.

source: Amidst paper rustling, Lumian’s smile faded, and his wrist slowed.
target: Inter crepūs chartārum, subrīsus Lumiani evanuit et carpus eius retardātus est.

source: Finally, he penned the unusually brief letter: “Honorable Madam Magician, I’d like to meet you.”
target: Denique scripsit epistolam insolitam brevissimam: “Honoranda Domina Magistra, te convenīre velim.”
